REPORT
MUNICIPAL POLICE
File No. REGISTRY
B. D. 7043
35
Date November 8, 35

Subject Anonymous letter dated October 31, 1935, addressed to Shanghai
Municipal Police re: a communist suspect named Wang Mu Ya
(王慕雅).
Made by D.I. Kuh Pao-hwa. Forwarded by J.B.Coo D.I.

With reference to the attached anonymous letter
dated October 31, 1935 reporting that Wang Mu Ya (王慕雅), a
teacher in the employ of the Shanghai Municipal Council
Poletechnic Public School for Chinese, Pakhoi Road, is suspected
of being a communist, the following is the result of enquiries
made by C.D.S.155 attached to Section 2.

Wang Mu Ya, the subject of the enquiry, has been in
the employ of the S.M.C. Poletechnic Public School for Chinese
as a teacher for the past six years. He resides with his wife
and family at No.6 Yu Yuen Terrace, Yu Yuen Road, where he
has been living for about twelve months. His description
is as follows:-

Age about 35, height 5'7", medium build, broad face,
fair complexion, long hair brushed back, wears white rimmed
spectacles. He was last seen dressed in a dark brown foreign
style suit and black leather shoes. Speaks the Soochow dialect.

Discreet enquiries made in the vicinity of Wang's
residence as well as at the place of his employment, together
with an unobstrusive watch kept on his movements generally,
have failed to show that he is connected with the activities
of the Chinese Communist Party. Furthermore, there is nothing
on record concerning him.

In view of the foregoing it would appear that spite
is the motive of the informant.

The postal cancellation chop on the envelope shows
that the letter was posted at the Rue Kraetzer Sub Post Office,
No.105 Rue Marco Polo, at 10 a.m. October 31, 1935.

Kuh Pao-hwa
D. I.
D. C. (Special Branch).

警务处 档案编号 登记处
B. D. 7043
35
日期：1935年11月8日

事由：关于一名名为王慕雅的共产党嫌疑分子的1935年10月31日匿名信。
呈报人：副督察 顾宝华 (Kuh Pao-hwa)。由副督察 J.B. Coo 转交。

关于随附的1935年10月31日匿名信，举报北海路工部局立格致公学雇佣的教师王慕雅涉嫌为共产党员一事，现将政治部第二股探员 C.D.S.155 的调查结果呈报如下：

被调查对象王慕雅在过去六年中一直受雇于工部局立格致公学担任教师。他与妻子及家人居住在愚园路愚园坊6号，已在此居住约十二个月。其特征如下：

年龄约35岁，身高5英尺7英寸，中等身材，阔脸，肤色白皙，长发向后梳，戴白框眼镜。最后一次见到他时，他身穿深褐色西装，脚穿黑色皮鞋。讲苏州话。

在王氏住所附近及其工作地点进行的秘密调查，以及对其日常行踪的暗中监视，均未能显示其与中国共产党的活动有关。此外，档案中亦无关于他的记录。

鉴于上述情况，举报人的动机似乎是出于恶意报复。

信封上的邮戳显示，该信件于1935年10月31日上午10时在葛罗路 (Rue Kraetzer) 邮政分局（马高蓬路 (Rue Marco Polo) 105号）投寄。

顾宝华 (Kuh Pao-hwa)
副督察 (D. I.)
政治部副督察 (D. C. Special Branch)

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
COMMISSIONER'S OFFICE.

Translation of Anonymous letter.

October 31, 1935.

To
Police Department,
Shanghai Municipal Council.

Gentlemen,
It has recently been discovered that
the movements of Wang Mu Ya, a teacher employed
at the S.M.C. School, Pakhoi Road (Polytechnic
Public School for Chinese?), are so suspicious
that he is probably a Communist. You are re-
quested to make inquiries. I bitterly hate
Communism as my brother was murdered by Communists.
To avenge the wrong, I submit the above informa-
tion.

(Signed): "Ch'lu, informant".

处长办公室

匿名信译文

1935年10月31日

致：
上海工部局
警务处

诸位先生：
最近发现，受雇于北海路工部局学校（格致公学？）的教师王慕雅行踪十分可疑，可能是一名共产党员。请予以调查。我深恶痛绝共产主义，因为我的兄弟被共产党杀害了。为了报仇雪恨，我提交上述情报。

（签名）：“举报人 仇 (Ch'lu) (音译)”。
